name: VacationRentalOwnerStatement
tagline: Close the month for every vacation-rental owner – reconcile, approve and pay owner statements in one Power Apps control.
description: A complete owner-statement app for short-term-rental managers: one statement per property and month with channel fees, management commission on gross or net, cleaning-fee handling, maintenance mark-up, owner stays, adjustments, reserve and net payout; a statements board from Open to Paid with owner-approval, receipt and dispute rules; a ledger with duplicate and missing-receipt checks; owner roll-ups and plain-text statements for e-mail. Works in canvas apps, model-driven apps and Power Pages owner portals.
features: Statement per property and month with full calculation
Channel fee rates or actual OTA fees
Management fee on gross or net of channel fees
Maintenance mark-up, owner stays, adjustments, owner reserve
Receipt required above a threshold; owner approval above a limit
Disputes and holds block approval; paid lines locked
Carry-forward below minimum payout; owner invoice for deficits
Plain-text owner statement and owner summary to Power Fx
Bulk reconcile / approve / dispute / export, undo
Phone layout with bottom view switcher
react: 16.14.0 bundled (no platform libraries, no Fluent UI)
controlType: standard (data-set control + Power Pages field control)
